visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands in front of a blue horizontal metal storefront shutter at night. She wears a cream-colored zip-up jacket with black stripes on the sleeves over a navy blue crop top and light blue denim jeans. A male hand enters the frame from the right, and they begin a rock-paper-scissors hand game. (2) The woman loses the game and reacts with a dramatic, playful expression, leaning back and laughing. She points at the camera/male partner with a big smile. The camera follows her movements in a handheld POV style as she moves side-to-side on the sidewalk. (3) They continue the game with rapid hand movements. She winces playfully as if being hit by the loser's penalty. She eventually turns and runs/walks away towards the street, where distant lights and figures are visible. The camera shakes slightly, following her in a playful chase sequence.
